subject: New Cat Species Identified for the First Time in Over 100 Years–Meet the Tilcayo

Exploring remote cloud forests yields a remarkable biological discovery: the first new wild cat species in over a century.
Evidence: Scientific discovery, Genetic taxonomy, Biodiversity exploration
